servers.risk_summary: The agent-council skill presents a clean security profile with no confirmed malicious indicators: no encoded payloads, no curl-pipe-bash patterns, no credential harvesting, and no suspicious external domains. The three medium-severity SAST findings are contextual false positives representing standard Discord API calls via Python's standard library. The primary residual risk is the 47-day-old account age combined with broad system capabilities (cron setup, gateway configuration, multi-agent orchestration), which warrants monitoring of future updates but does not block approval of the current version.

openclaw-sec is a substantive security detection library whose high-severity SAST findings are overwhelmingly false positives arising from scanner context collapse — the tool's own detection patterns and test fixtures are being flagged as live credentials and malicious code. The primary residual risk is the unaudited hook installation mechanism (user-prompt-submit-hook.ts, tool-call-hook.ts, install-hooks.sh), which installs persistent hooks intercepting all agent interactions and whose source code is not present in the scan evidence. A 47-day-old account publishing a security tool with persistent hook capabilities warrants conditional approval pending hook code review.
